user_saw: Starting a suggested task in a new session or worktree switched to the new conversation and took the current draft out of view.
summary: The Control UI now launches suggested tasks in new sessions or worktrees in the background, keeping the current conversation and draft open.
reasoning: I checked the original follow-up feature in PR #102422, which added automatic navigation on worktree acceptance and documented that accepted suggestions open a fresh session. PR #145019 explicitly tested navigation for new-session and worktree launches, so this fix changes the established interaction to background launching.
